purpose: The constants of GenEPLB's warm-up cost-model micro-benchmark (geneplb/costmb.py, run by balancer.before_capture between the CUDA-graph warmup's pass 1 and pass 2): the designs, timing and fit constants of the reference warm-up fitter, with a true hold-out (every 4th design per family, cold-start train fits, refit of the selected model on all designs). Every rank reads this file; the sha256 of the effective configuration (this file + the TLLM_GENEPLB_COSTMB_* env overrides) joins the identity vote.

designs.source: 6 families x 32 = 192 designs per tier, seed 20261102, 20 attempts; holdout_every 4 = the true hold-out (costmb.py make_designs: holdout = index % 4 == 3, i.e. 8 of 32 per family). _fix_total keeps the EP*T*K largest slots when a design has more active slots than routes (EP16 M28 T4 would otherwise raise 'no slot left'; never triggers at the reference golden geometries).

timing.source: per design and rep: device sleep >= sleep_host_factor x (warm + timed) x the slowest rank's host enqueue ms, 2 warm launches, CUDA event, 8 timed launches, CUDA event; the first 4 staged layers launched in turn; 2 reps in a seed-shared order. cap_s: the rank-identical wall cap, decided once from the all-gathered host enqueue / launch ms of the fixed warm launches before the first timed launch: over the cap reps drop to 1, then the tiers past the cap (configured order) take their fallback rows.

fit.source: forms base / hot, weights >= 0, damped Gauss-Newton with a tau homotopy 4 -> 0.05 from 6 starts; candidates base and hot at tau 0.05 (the hard max) and hot at each LSE tau; select_tol per B preset tier = costmodel.tier_of(T). Selection and acceptance on the TRUE hold-out (costmb.py fit_models): every candidate fitted on the train designs only from the cold starts, the lowest hold-out RMSE, then the smallest-tau LSE model within select_tol of it, refitted on all designs. pin_min_crossing_designs: a tier where fewer designs than this have a slot above one tile (EP x T <= tile: Lt = H = 0 everywhere) cannot identify cl / ch; they are pinned to the nearest accepted identifiable tier of the same bucket, else to the tier's fallback row.

accept.source: hold-out RMSE <= max(3 us, 5 % of the mean y) (an in-sample bar of max(2 us, 3 %) accepts fits whose hold-out error is larger: EP32 T128 fits have a hold-out CV of 3.1-4.9 us) and the coefficient bounds (cl lower bound 0); a tier failing either takes its sealed fallback row on every rank.

tiers.source: the decode buckets of the tuned deployments (rows per rank = CUDA-graph batch x 4 with a 3-token draft): GEN DEP16 b8..b48 -> T 32..192 (bucket 256) plus one bucket-512 tier (b96 -> T 384); GEN DEP32 b2..b8 -> T 8 / 16 / 32. Tiers above the largest decode graph's T are dropped (rank-identical: every rank captures the same graphs). Another EP: the decode graphs' T values >= 8, thinned to default_max_tiers. TLLM_GENEPLB_COSTMB_TIERS=<t,t,..> overrides (kept as given). A tier must lie strictly below its MegaMoE launch bucket (T == bucket would take the direct-input path that B never uses).
